newsitem.title: USA: Anadigics to supply Ericsson phone.
newsitem.headline: Anadigics to supply Ericsson phone.

text.p: Sweden's Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson has selected a power amplifier made by Anadigics Inc for its latest digital mobile phone, Anadigics said on Wednesday.

Ericsson is using the company's AWT0908 900 MHz global system mobile single supply power amplifier IC for its GF 788 GSM phone, described as the smallest, most sophisticated mobile phone on the market. The phone is small enough to fit in the palm of a hand, according to a statement issued by Anadigics.
"This order represents our ongoing efforts to broaden both our presence in the cellular market and our line of products for the GSM standard," it said, referring to the global system mobile standard.
